title: THE ARMOUR CALLOUT IS CAPS WORDS
why: The cloud review of 2026-10-15 (finding 29): the one HUD callout that was still a sentence. The first time you shoot a Warden or a Bulwark through its armour the callout read Hit its back. or Flank it. in sentence case with a full stop, against the terse caps rule. It now reads HIT ITS BACK and FLANK IT under the machine name.
now: The Warden and Bulwark armour callout now reads HIT ITS BACK and FLANK IT in caps.
